scientific_interpretation: In true tissue biopsy data from GSE62928, the 7 consensus hub genes exhibit modest directional concordance (2/7 concordant; LTB and ADAM19 positive; binomial P = 0.4531). The composite hub score yields an AUC of 0.4375 (one-sided Mann-Whitney P = 0.6571; two-sided P = 0.8857); the 1,000 random 7-gene-set null has mean AUC 0.4798 and empirical P = 0.6040. The discovery effluent and validation biopsy cohorts differ in tissue and phenotype, limiting transportability. The previous AUC = 1.0 resulted from synthetic shifted data and in-sample model fitting in the legacy pipeline.
